session_summary: As the Combat Challenger, I completed the Frostfang Pass route (difficulty 3) encountering only 2 enemies (Slime and Kobold) across 12 steps. The encounter pacing feels extremely sparse for a high-difficulty route, lacking the active pressure, tactical positioning, and mastery challenge expected from a tier-3 zone.

observations.evidence: Frostfang Pass telemetry shows only 2 enemy encounters (Slime at step 2, Kobold at step 11) over a 12-step traversal.
observations.recommendation: Increase enemy density and introduce consecutive or elite encounter patterns on difficulty 3 routes to match the Combat Challenger persona expectations.

observations.evidence: Completing Frostfang Pass rewarded 25 coins with zero HP lost (final HP 100), despite it being rated as difficulty 3.
observations.recommendation: Tie high-difficulty route rewards more closely to engagement risk and introduce scaling modifiers that reward skillful execution.

feature_requests.title: Elite Combat Encounters & Aggressive Enemy Profiles
feature_requests.player_value: Provides a high-tension challenge that rewards mastery and strategic combat decision-making on difficult routes.
feature_requests.rationale: Current routes feature very few encounters relative to movement steps, reducing the mechanical depth of combat.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add tighter encounter spacing and content pack variants featuring aggressive enemy configurations on difficulty 3+ routes.

keep: Clean route completion telemetry tracking and clear step-by-step action logs.
The thematic design of hazards like ice spikes and hot plates that interact with player movement.
focus: encounter pacing, enemy friction, risk/reward, challenge and mastery
